prompt:
Create a polished, exceptionally clean MOBILE STRATEGY GAME UI component comparison sheet, landscape 1500x1050. The attached image is the APPROVED visual reference, variant C Crisp buttons. Match its circular candy-button nodes exactly: shallow domed smooth M&M-like candy faces, narrow rounded bevel, gentle top-left sheen, very tight soft shadow, soft mint green and cyan and warm ivory, very dark upright rounded legible numerals. Do not reproduce the old approval image's whole layout. This is a focused design study, not a poster or device mockup.
Fixed palette: almost-white warm ground, mint/lime green and cyan nodes, charcoal ink, navy night strip. Keep the FACE and COUNT AREA totally clear: no symbol on top of the numeral, no rotated bars, no noisy highlights over the number. Counts must be centered and legible. Subtle 3D, not spherical marbles, not thick plastic toys. Real crisp designed icons, no emoji, no logos. No crowns, AI icons, or flags anywhere; the user has explicitly removed those.
Include enough whitespace to show the differences cleanly. Draw the nodes at actual plausible game proportions, not icons so huge they would cover a node. Use exact short labels and a consistent modern rounded sans similar to Quicksand. Every sample must look like part of the SAME approved game visual system. No typography experiments or new palette.
TITLE exactly "Shields".
Make THREE clearly separated rows of shield treatments, and THREE columns of strength states. Columns are labeled once at top: "Low", "Half", "Full". A small plain label says "Capacity 14". Every node face is the same cyan candy button with a centered population count 35. The shields' values 1, 7, 14 appear only in their own tiny separate badge; never put shield value on the population number.
Row "S1 · Smooth arc": a SINGLE very fine cyan outer progress arc at radius just beyond the candy node, low/half/full progress corresponding to 1/14,7/14,14/14. No thick tracks, broad rings or decorative halo. A tiny white pill below contains a very small outline shield icon and the current shield value 1, 7, or 14. Maintain a clean gap between arc and button.
Row "S2 · Four segments": four neatly separated thin cyan arc segments outside the node, lit proportionally at low/half/full, unused portions pale and quiet. Never 14 tiny pips. A tiny separate white shield-count badge below shows 1, 7, or 14. Preserve the approved reference's clean segmented style and clear centered count.
Row "S3 · Badge only": NO rings or arcs around the node, only a compact attached lower-right white pill with a tiny shield glyph and shield count 1, 7, or 14; shield glyph fill changes proportionally as the value rises. This is the calmest and most compact option. The badge is small and does not obscure the 35.
All nine samples are perfectly aligned with identical node size so the shield choices compare fairly. Each row label belongs once at the left margin, not repeated by every node.
Along the bottom, a narrow navy strip shows one small cyan node from each shield treatment at half strength, with crisp readable 35 and shield7. No economy/tower badges, AI symbols, routes, arrows, flags or crowns anywhere.
